description: This file implements an HTTP server for handling specific device management requests in a TR-069 host interface. It uses libSoup to listen for incoming HTTP requests on a specified port, parses JSON request payloads with cJSON, and responds accordingly by invoking request handler functions. The server supports GET and POST methods, manages request/response JSON objects, and provides start/stop control functions for the HTTP server in a multi-threaded environment.

methods.name: void HTTPRequestHandler(SoupServer * server,SoupServerMessage * msg,const char * path,GHashTable * query,void * user_data)
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, parses JSON payloads, processes GET or POST requests via handleRequest, and formulates JSON responses accordingly.

methods.name: void * HTTPServerStartThread(void * msg)
methods.description: Initializes and starts the libSoup HTTP server, sets up request handler, and signals readiness through a condition variable.

methods.name: void HttpServerStop()
methods.description: Stops the running HTTP server and disconnects the libSoup server instance.
